# Merriam-Webster

> The authoritative source for English language definitions, thesauruses, and reference materials serving learners, students, and language professionals worldwide.

Merriam-Webster provides comprehensive dictionary and thesaurus resources across multiple formats and reading levels, from children's educational materials to the unabridged dictionary containing 700,000+ definitions. The site offers both free and premium subscription access to language reference tools, vocabulary learning resources, and specialized dictionaries including bilingual and SCRABBLE editions.

## Key Topics

- Unabridged Dictionary
- Collegiate Dictionary
- Word Definitions
- Thesaurus
- Vocabulary Building
- Language Learning
- Premium Membership
- Educational Resources
- Slang Dictionary
- Dictionary Shop
- Britannica Premium
- Etymology
- Reference Books
- Children's Dictionaries
- Bilingual Dictionaries

## Core Dictionary & Reference

- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com): Comprehensive unabridged dictionary with 700,000+ definitions and unlimited access
- [Slang Dictionary - Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Slang dictionary with trending words, phrases, and contemporary vocabulary definitions

## Shop & Product Collections

- [Merriam-Webster Dictionaries – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com): Official Merriam-Webster shop featuring dictionaries, thesauruses, and reference books
- [Shop For Dictionaries – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/dictionaries): Dictionary product catalog with specialized and bilingual dictionary collections
- [Shop For Thesauruses – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/thesauruses): Thesaurus product collection for vocabulary building and language learning
- [Shop Titles for Kids – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/elementary): Educational books and reference materials for children's vocabulary building

## Subscriptions & Membership

- [Merriam-Webster Unabridged - Encyclopædia Britannica, Inc.](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/check-redirect-premium): Britannica & Merriam-Webster premium membership subscription options

## Educational & Community Programs

- [Support Schools in Your Community! – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/support-the-children-in-your-community): Bulk discount program for schools and nonprofits supporting educational resources
